text:
oliver: quick flag  onboarding nx13b-int4 on staging revealed a tokenizer drift vs our canonical tokenizer. some prompts that previously stayed under 4k tokens are now getting an extra token, causing kv-cache misalignment and surprising truncation in long conversations. want to assemble a tokenizer-sensitive mini-golden + dedupe before we escalate rollout.
jena: ouch. do you have examples? can you paste an excerpt of mutated tokenization?
oliver: yep, here's a short pair (orig -> new tokenize display):
```
orig: "\u201cJohn's e-mail: john.doe@example.com\u201d" -> tokens: [..., "john", ".", "doe", "@", "example", ".", "com"]
new : "\u201cJohn's e-mail: john.doe@example.com\u201d" -> tokens: [..., "john", ".doe", "@example", ".com"]
```
oliver: the join of punctuation changes embedding sim and our fuzzyhash dedupe, so we end up with near-duplicates that slip into the golden and skew recall. also saw a couple of codeblock indents get tokenized as extra leading tokens which shifted offsets.
pat: this is curation + eval. proposal: 1) build mini-golden of 180 items focused on token boundary sensitivity (emails, urls, codeblocks, markdown, dates) 2) run tokenwalk dedupe (token-aware paraphrase detection) + embed-sim 3) 3-way label consensus with tokenized-alignment QA.
jena: +1. for dedupe use `scripts/tokenwalk_dedupe.sh --threshold 0.85 --align` and also run legacy fuzzyhash as a fallback. set manual review for collisions that disagree between methods.
oliver: capacity request: want 180 items, but include a 40-item fast lane of high-risk production prompts (RAG summaries, multi-doc concatenations). pat: we can do 3-way consensus on 180 in ~30h with 10 labelers; the 40 fast-lane can be prioritized to finish within 8h.
labeler-bot: created task ML-GOLD-172500 for "nx13b-int4 tokenizer-sensitive mini-golden". 180 items assigned; fast-lane 40 flagged. ETA 36h. :robot_face:
ops: FYI  staging nodes have an updated tokenizer wheel deployed in test images. if you need to run side-by-side hashes against old tokenizer, use `--tokenizer=/opt/tokenizers/canonical:v1` parameter in the canary driver. increase staging quota for parallel evals need to be requested 2h ahead.
pat: labeling instructions: 1) verify semantic recall (primary) 2) marker-level alignment check (did any entity tokens collapse or merge?) 3) mark `TOKEN_SPLIT` or `TOKEN_JOIN` when behavior differs. use the golden rubric and add a short checklist: token alignment screenshot required for any TOKEN_* tag. link: https://confluence.redwood.ai/curation/token-golden-guidelines
jena: after relabel, run `eval/harness/compare_token_sensitive.py --models nx13b-fp16,nx13b-int4 --gold mini-gold-tokenizer-v1` and output per-tag diffs (TOKEN_JOIN rate, recall, rougeL).
azoliver: starting a dedupe pass now with tokenwalk + embed-sim. will post collisions.
oliver: dedupe results estimate: 22% collisions, ~12 manual triage items. kicking to labelers.
labeler-bot: dedupe complete; collisions exported s3://redwood-qa/nx13b-tokenwalk/172500/collisions.ndjson. launching ML-GOLD-172500-labeling.
pat: small note  ensure labelers see both tokenized renderings (old vs new) to make consistent judgments. instruct them to prefer semantic content if token differences are syntactic.
jaz: i'll QA label instructions and add a quick training snippet (2 examples) in the task.
labeler-bot: relabel complete: 180 input -> consensus 168 items (12 abstains). fast-lane 40 -> consensus 38 (2 abstains). uploading to s3: s3://redwood-qa/nx13b-tokenwalk/172500/results.json
oliver: running eval now on the consensus set. early numbers:
```
metric               fp16    int4     delta
-------------------------------------------
token_join_rate      0.007   0.032    +0.025
long_recall@20       0.847   0.833    -0.014
rougeL               0.452   0.448    -0.004
avg_latency(ms)      260     175      -85
cost/tok             1.00    0.49     -51%
```
oliver: token_join_rate increase is notable, but semantic recall impact is under the 2% threshold we set for this app.
jena: can we try a targeted prompt-engineering patch for the fast-lane 40 (explicit token hint: "preserve punctuation spacing") and re-eval that subset? if that closes token_join without label rework, we can avoid more relabeling.
pat: yes, we can add prompt scaffold B to the 40 and run a quick eval; labelers can QA just the 40 in ~6h.
oliver: doing scaffold B now and re-running harness for the 40.
labeler-bot: added task ML-GOLD-172500-fastlane for scaffold B checks. 10 labelers assigned, ETA 6h.
oliver: fast-lane re-eval results: token_join_rate on 40 -> 0.010 (was 0.038), long_recall@20 delta now -0.005 vs fp16. pretty good.
jena: excellent. recommendation: proceed to a limited dedicated canary with the new tokenizer deployed and prompt scaffold B as a mitigation. gate conditions: hold if token_join_rate > 1.5% or long_recall drop > 1.2% on the rolling 24h.
pat: I'll update the golden registry entry: `nx13b-int4-tokenwalk-mini-20250115` and attach consensus S3 path and dedupe artifact.
oliver: filing rollout ticket RW-172500 with the canary checklist, dashboards (token_join, ENTITY_FLIP, long_recall), and owners. thanks team.
labeler-bot: note: ML-GOLD-172500 archived. artifacts: s3://redwood-qa/nx13b-tokenwalk/172500/ (results, collisions, audit-traces). :file_folder:
